scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.precommit:check: npm run test:backend && npm run lint && npm run test:frontend
scripts.coverage: npm --prefix backend run coverage && npm --prefix frontend run coverage
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACK,FRONT -c green,blue "npm run dev:back" "npm run dev:front"
